title: In PRAISE of Attributes: Grounding Retrieval Geometry with Query-Conditioned Subspaces for Person Re-Identification
title_zh: 【输入内容第一行】的中文翻译：属性之赞：基于查询条件子空间为行人重识别奠定检索几何基础

paragraphs.en: 文章提出PRAISE框架，利用属性条件子空间对基于视觉语言模型的行人重识别进行查询侧测试时自适应，显著提升检索性能。 Person re-identification (ReID) ranks an image gallery using either an image query or a textual query. In image-to-image (I2I) ReID, viewpoint, illumination, occlusion, and background changes can make distractors appear more similar than the true match. In text-to-image (T2I) ReID, incomplete or ambiguous descriptions may omit key visual evidence. We study this problem for vision-language model (VLM) based ReID, where attributes such as clothing color and carried objects provide useful fine-grained matching cues. However, directly using attribute-prompt similarities as retrieval scores is unreliable because templated prompts can be biased, correlated, and poorly calibrated. We therefore propose \textbf{PR}ompt-guided \textbf{A}ttribute-based \textbf{I}nference-time \textbf{S}imilarity \textbf{E}nhancement (\texttt{PRAISE}), a query-side test-time adaptation framework for VLM-based ReID. Instead of treating prompts as scores, \texttt{PRAISE} uses a transferable attribute-prompt bank to construct an \emph{Attribute-Conditioned Subspace} (ACS): a query-dependent low-rank subspace induced by the most compatible attribute prompts. ACS provides a controlled attribute-conditioned geometry for reshaping query--gallery affinities and guiding lightweight inference-time updates without identity or attribute labels. Experiments across multiple I2I- and T2I-ReID benchmarks show that \texttt{PRAISE} consistently improves VLM retrieval backbones and outperforms both generic and ReID-specific TTA baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 文章提出PRAISE框架，利用属性条件子空间对基于视觉语言模型的行人重识别进行查询侧测试时自适应，显著提升检索性能。行人重识别（ReID）利用图像查询或文本查询对图像库进行排序。 在图像到图像（I2I）重识别中，视角、光照、遮挡和背景的变化可能使干扰项看起来比真正的匹配对象更相似。 在文本到图像（T2I）重识别中，不完整或模糊的描述可能遗漏关键的视觉证据。 我们针对基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的重识别研究这一问题，其中诸如衣服颜色和随身物品等属性提供了有用的细粒度匹配线索。 然而，直接将属性-提示相似度作为检索分数并不可靠，因为模板化提示可能存在偏差、相互关联且校准不佳。 因此，我们提出提示引导的基于属性的推理时相似度增强（\texttt{PRAISE}），这是一个面向基于VLM的重识别的查询侧测试时自适应框架。 \texttt{PRAISE}不是将提示直接当作分数，而是使用一个可迁移的属性-提示库来构建属性条件子空间（ACS）：一个由最兼容的属性提示所诱导的、依赖于查询的低秩子空间。 ACS提供了一种受控的属性条件几何结构，用于重塑查询-图库的亲和度，并在无需身份或属性标签的情况下引导轻量级的推理时更新。 在多个I2I和T2I重识别基准上的实验表明，\texttt{PRAISE}能持续提升VLM检索主干网络的性能，并优于通用及重识别专用的测试时自适应基线方法。
